basic_details.job_title: MTWU Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline for 2 Registrar, Controller of Examinations Posts
basic_details.short_information: Mother Teresa Women's University, Kodaikanal (Dindigul District, Tamil Nadu) has invited applications from suitable women candidates for the post of Registrar and Controller of Examinations at Pay Matrix Level 14 plus allowances admissible under University rules, for a term of 3 years at a time. Fifteen years of experience is required, and the filled-in application in eight copies must reach the University by 5 December 2026 under Notification No. 401.

application_fee.details: The fee is paid as an SBI demand draft drawn in favour of "The Registrar, Mother Teresa Women's University", payable at Kodaikanal. It is not refunded under any circumstances.

selection_process: The University reserves its right to shortlist the candidates. Candidates called for the interview will not be paid any TA/DA. The notice does not describe the interview marks or other stages.
how_to_apply: Download the application form from the University website, www.motherteresawomenuniv.ac.in. The form is also printed in the notice.
Fill in the form in the prescribed format and affix a recent passport size photo. Forms not in the prescribed format will be rejected without intimation.
Send eight copies of the application with bio-data: three copies with complete enclosures and five copies without enclosures.
Enclose the SBI demand draft for the application fee, and attested photocopies of certificates proving age, educational qualifications and experience.
Candidates already in service must apply through proper channel or produce a No Objection Certificate from the employer.
Make sure the application is received by 05.12.2026. Late applications will not be considered, and the University is not responsible for delay in transit.

The notice does not print a separate postal address for sending applications. The University's address given in the notice is Mother Teresa Women's University, Attuvampatty, Kodaikanal-624 101, Dindigul District, Tamilnadu.
Documents named in the notice and its application form:
Attested copies of academic certificates, from the most recent degree back to Matriculation or S.S.L.C.
Proof of age, experience and administrative experience.
Testimonials from two persons, one from the Head of the Institution last attended.
Names and addresses of at least two persons, not related by blood or marriage, for confidential reference.
Details of the fee demand draft (bank, DD number, amount, date).
The form also asks for research papers, publications, research guidance, languages known, a 200-word note on current and future University plans, and a declaration with signature.
important_instructions: Canvassing in any form will be a disqualification. The notice gives the University's own right to shortlist; it does not guarantee an interview call. The application form asks whether any vigilance, disciplinary or legal case is pending, and asks for the period required to join duty if offered the post. False or incorrect information will lead to cancellation of candidature or appointment, as per the declaration in the form.

content_sections.heading: About Mother Teresa Women's University
content_sections.text: Mother Teresa Women's University is a university established under the Act of Tamil Nadu 1984. Its address in the notice is Attuvampatty, Kodaikanal-624 101, Dindigul District, Tamilnadu. The notice is signed by the Registrar i/c and dated 06.11.2026 at Kodaikanal.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: The holder of the post shall be an academician not lower than that of a University Professor. A Master Degree with at least 55% of the marks or its equivalent grade of B in the UGC seven-point scale. At least 15 years of experience as Assistant Professor in the AGP of Rs.7000/- and above, or 8 years of service in the AGP of Rs.8000 and above including as Associate Professor, along with experience in educational administration. OR comparable experience in a research establishment and (or) other institutions of higher education. OR 15 years of administrative experience, of which 8 years as Deputy Registrar or an equivalent post. Knowledge of Tamil is essential (written and spoken). Qualification is relaxable in exceptional cases. Age: the notice states that the age of superannuation for the post is 58 years. It prints no separate minimum or maximum age for applying. Only women candidates are invited. Candidates should check the UGC prescribed qualifications before applying. M.Phil. and Ph.D. degrees obtained through Correspondence, Distance Education or the Open University System are ineligible for Government appointments.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms
content_sections.text: The pay is Pay Matrix Level 14 plus allowances admissible under the rules of the University. The notice prints no rupee amount. The term of appointment is 3 years at a time. The University reserves the right to fill up or not to fill up the post.

content_sections.heading: Application Fee

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date for Mother Teresa Women's University Registrar recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date for receipt of the filled-in application is 05.12.2026. Late applications will not be considered.

faq.question: Q2. Who can apply for the Registrar and Controller of Examinations post?
faq.answer: The notice invites applications from suitable women candidates. The holder must be an academician not lower than a University Professor.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification required?
faq.answer: A Master Degree with at least 55% of the marks or its equivalent grade of B in the UGC seven-point scale, plus the experience described in the notice. Qualification is relaxable in exceptional cases.

faq.question: Q4. How many years of experience are needed?
faq.answer: At least 15 years as Assistant Professor in AGP Rs.7000/- and above, or 8 years in AGP Rs.8000 and above including as Associate Professor with educational administration experience. Other alternatives are comparable research or higher education experience, or 15 years of administrative experience including 8 years as Deputy Registrar or equivalent.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age of superannuation?
faq.answer: The age of superannuation for the post is 58 years, as printed in the notice.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee?
faq.answer: The fee is 1000/- for General and 500/- for SC/SCA/ST, paid by SBI demand draft in favour of "The Registrar, Mother Teresa Women's University", payable at Kodaikanal. It is not refunded.

faq.question: Q7. How do I apply?
faq.answer: Download the form from www.motherteresawomenuniv.ac.in, fill it in and send eight copies: three with complete enclosures and five without, along with the demand draft.

faq.question: Q8. What is the pay and tenure of the post?
faq.answer: The pay is Pay Matrix Level 14 plus allowances admissible under University rules. The term of appointment is 3 years at a time.

faq.question: Q9. Is knowledge of Tamil required?
faq.answer: Yes, knowledge of Tamil (written and spoken) is essential.

faq.question: Q10. Do candidates already in service need permission?
faq.answer: Candidates already in service must send their application through proper channel or produce a No Objection Certificate from the employer. Interview candidates will not be paid TA/DA.
